steps.label: pdml-parent
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE PDMLParent(id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: pdml-child
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE PDMLChild(id INT64 NOT NULL,child INT64 NOT NULL,val INT64,generated INT64 AS(val+1) STORED) PRIMARY KEY(id,child), INTERLEAVE IN PARENT PDMLParent

steps.label: pdml-read-0
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM PDMLChild ORDER BY child

steps.label: pdml-update-0
